react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolites form a tightly coherent eicosanoid cluster. Across three orthogonal enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-database ORA (FDR = 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁵), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.5 × 10⁻⁶), and Mummichog m/z-direct activity scoring (p = 8.4 × 10⁻⁵) — the top pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism / eicosanoid synthesis. In the RaMP result, five input metabolites hit the WikiPathways 'Eicosanoid synthesis' (WP:WP167) pathway out of 27 members, giving a fold-enrichment of 2001×. The same five (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, Leukotriene A4, and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2) are confirmed members of that pathway via the metabolites_hit roster. The KEGG counterpart KEGG:hsa00590 ('Arachidonic acid metabolism') captures four of the same metabolites (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, Leukotriene A4) and is the sole significant KEGG hit. Mummichog's empirical-compound network additionally returns 'Leukotriene metabolism' (p = 0.024) and 'Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p = 0.033) as secondary winners. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the upstream substrate feeding all observed products (5-HETE, 15-HETE, 5,6-EET, LTA4, 15d-PGJ2), making it the primary driver metabolite. The simultaneous elevation of lipoxygenase products (5-HETE, 15-HETE, LTA4) alongside a cyclopentenone prostaglandin (15d-PGJ2) suggests activation of both the LOX and COX branches of the arachidonic acid cascade, consistent with an inflammatory or oxidative-stress stimulus. The two phenolic acids (4-hydroxybenzoic acid, 3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid) are not represented in any hit list and appear to be background-noise metabolites not connected to the eicosanoid signal.

5-HETE (KEGG:C04805) was identified as a member of Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167).

Leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909) was identified as a member of Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167).
Arachidonic acid is the shared substrate of Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism).

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolites form a tightly coherent eicosanoid cluster. Across three orthogonal enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-database ORA (FDR = 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁵), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.5 × 10⁻⁶), and Mummichog m/z-direct activity scoring (p = 8.4 × 10⁻⁵) — the top pathway is arachidonic acid metabolism / eicosanoid synthesis. In the RaMP result, five input metabolites hit the WikiPathways 'Eicosanoid synthesis' (WP:WP167) pathway out of 27 members, giving a fold-enrichment of 2001×. The same five (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, Leukotriene A4, and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-PGJ2) are confirmed members of that pathway via the metabolites_hit roster. The KEGG counterpart KEGG:hsa00590 ('Arachidonic acid metabolism') captures four of the same metabolites (arachidonic acid, 5-HETE, 15-HETE, Leukotriene A4) and is the sole significant KEGG hit. Mummichog's empirical-compound network additionally returns 'Leukotriene metabolism' (p = 0.024) and 'Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p = 0.033) as secondary winners. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the upstream substrate feeding all observed products (5-HETE, 15-HETE, 5,6-EET, LTA4, 15d-PGJ2), making it the primary driver metabolite. The simultaneous elevation of lipoxygenase products (5-HETE, 15-HETE, LTA4) alongside a cyclopentenone prostaglandin (15d-PGJ2) suggests activation of both the LOX and COX branches of the arachidonic acid cascade, consistent with an inflammatory or oxidative-stress stimulus. The two phenolic acids (4-hydroxybenzoic acid, 3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid) are not represented in any hit list and appear to be background-noise metabolites not connected to the eicosanoid signal.
